verdict.rationale: ReadMe's docs say it turns an uploaded OpenAPI (OAS) file into interactive API reference pages and lists the accepted OpenAPI versions and file types. Its Git workflows let teams keep Markdown and OpenAPI definitions in a repository and sync them two-way with the ReadMe project, which supports keeping the reference current as the spec changes. A community comment says ReadMe has better Swagger support than Docusaurus. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that reference pages regenerate automatically when the spec changes (e.g., CI upload via the rdme CLI), and hands-on corroboration that sync works reliably.
